Amazon Business Japan is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own selection for business customers. You will decide what products we need to offer to support Japanese customers, from small businesses to large multi-national organizations, as well as institutional buyers like universities, schools, hospitals and public offices. You will find where we have opportunities to serve them better, and build the mechanisms that close those gaps at Amazon scale.

Our team's mission is to make Amazon Business the solution Japanese businesses trust for their purchasing. The team is responsible for pricing, selection, quotation, and in-stock availability for all the products Amazon Business offers.

You will directly contribute to the growth of the business by making sure Amazon carries the products our customers need, in the sizes they need, from individual units to bulk quantity offerings.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

What we expect from this role:
- Own the selection strategy and goals for business customers in Japan, and the analysis and reporting behind them
- Identify gaps between what business customers want to buy and what is available today, using purchase data, search data, customer feedback and benchmarks, and size the opportunity for each
- Build mechanisms that find missing or unavailable products systematically and route them to the teams that can add or recover them, so the work scales beyond manual, one-at-a-time evaluation
- Drive adoption with the teams that add and manage selection: Japan retail category teams, brand and vendor management, third-party seller teams, and global Amazon Business product teams
- Communicate progress, risks and plans to leadership with data

Why you would want this role:
- The team is high performing and likes to have fun
- Selection is the foundation of the business customer experience. When you fix a gap, customers who could not buy from us before can, and you see it in the numbers within weeks
- You own the problem end to end, from customer research to goal setting to the mechanisms that deliver it
- We invest in automation and AI to enable new capabilities and you will have room to build

Key job responsibilities
- Assess voice of customers, purchase and search data, and benchmarks to identify selection gaps for business customers in Japan, and size the opportunity for each.
- Define and own Japan selection goals for business customers, including the analysis, targets and reporting behind them, and communicate progress, risks and plans to leadership.
- Build and maintain mechanisms that identify missing or unavailable products systematically, prioritize them by customer impact, and route them to the teams that can add or recover them.
- Work closely with the global Amazon Business product and program management teams to understand the mid- to long-term selection roadmap and reflect Japan-specific requirements.
- Partner with the sales teams who work with business customers daily to capture selection requests from customer deals and turn recurring requests into standing programs.
- Partner with Legal, Compliance, Tax and Finance to assess requirements when new product categories or programs are introduced.

A day in the life
Your week centers on one question: what do business customers in Japan want to buy that they cannot buy from us today and do we have the right plans to solve this problem ? Mornings may start with data, reviewing progress on initiatives and what the sales teams heard from customers.
When you find an opportunity, you surface it and collaboratively identify and drive a solution. The rest of your time goes into building mechanisms that solve Customers problems at scale.

WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON​

Gameloft Barcelona is seeking a Data Scientist to join Gameloft Global Data team.
As a Data Scientist, you will be able to deep dive into our massive streams of player data in-game, prototype and deploy machine learning models to increase game revenue. You will help move projects from exploratory analysis to deployed models across live titles, including life-simulation and racing games.

What it means on a daily basis​

• Analyse large-scale player data with Python and SQL, transforming it into clear, actionable insights.

• Prototype and improve machine learning models and prediction pipelines, using experimental design, causal inference, and A/B testing to raise performance baselines.
• Present findings and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders across the game teams.

What success will look like​

In your first months, you will ramp up on our data infrastructure and deliver your first exploratory analyses.By the middle of your onboarding, you will be responsible for features or models end-to-end, framing problems clearly and presenting them to non-technical stakeholders. By the end of your onboarding, you will be conducting experiments and delivering improvements on your own, with your insights adopted across the game teams.

Who you will be working with

As a Data Scientist in our Global Data Science and Analytics team, you will be reporting to our Lead Data Scientist and collaborate very closely with other Data teams (Data Analyst, Data Engineering) and with our local Game teams. Our teams operate across multiple studios worldwide, including Paris, Barcelona, Montreal, Sofia, Bucharest, and others, offering opportunities to collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

Your recruitment journey​

• First interview: An initial discussion to explore how the role aligns with your background and to address your main questions.​
• Test: You will be given a case study to complete.​
• Second interview: A technical interview focused on presenting your test and discussing your approach, reasoning, and methodologies in more depth.​
• Final interview: A conversation to discuss your experience, vision, and how you approach data topics at a broader level.​

​Where this role can take you​

This role can be a stepping stone toward a more senior position, with the possibility of leading increasingly large and complex projects, so that your work shapes game performance and business results more widely over time.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED​

• Proficient in Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, Matplotlib, seaborn) and in SQL for large-scale data analysis.
• Skilled in machine learning workflows, including experimental design, causal inference, and A/B testing.
• Experienced with Git and comfortable working with large-scale data in a data warehouse environment.
• Master's degree in a quantitative field (computer science, applied mathematics, data science, or related).

WHO YOU ARE​

•

Able to communicate and present to non-technical stakeholders in English, translating analytical work into clear, actionable recommendations.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU​

Benefits

• 25 vacation days per year + Birthday day off.
• Private medical health insurance.
• Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card.

회사 소개

CLS (Coupang Logistics Services)는 택배사업, 화물운송, 화물주선, 물류창고, 화물분류 등 종합 물류 서비스를 제공하는 쿠팡의 물류전문 계열사입니다. CLS는 국토교통부로 지정 받은 택배운송사업자로서 전국단위의 배송캠프에서 업계 최초로 도입한 분류작업전담인력과 직영 전문 배송직 쿠팡친구, 그리고 전국 단위 택배 영업점을 통해 고객에게 최적의 배송서비스를 제공하면서 쿠팡의 로켓배송을 완결하는 역할을 담당하고 있습니다. 로켓배송을 통해 미래 물류의 혁신을 이끌어 온 종합물류서비스 기업으로서 CLS는 로켓배송의 노하우, 인프라, 네트워크 등을 연계하여 물류 혁신을 통한 더 나은 고객감동을 만들어 나갈 것입니다.

직무 소개

IM(Inclusion Management) 팀은 장애인 채용 및 장애인 직원 인사관리를 전담하는 조직으로, 조직의 지속가능한 성장을 위해 다양성과 포용성을 기반으로 한 인사 운영을 수행합니다.

본 팀은 장애인 채용을 중심으로 채용 전략 수립, 채용 운영, 채용 데이터 관리, 직무 매칭, 채용 프로세스 개선을 담당하며, 입사 이후에는 인사 운영 및 인사 제도 관리를 통해 구성원들이 안정적으로 근무하고 역량을 발휘할 수 있도록 지원합니다.

또한 채용 및 인사 운영 과정에서 발생하는 다양한 데이터를 기반으로 성과를 분석하고 논리적으로 설명하며, 보다 합리적인 의사결정이 이루어질 수 있도록 지원하는 역할을 수행합니다.

IM 팀은 장애인 직원들에 대해 채용–배치–인사운영–복리후생, ER 등 종합적으로 HR 사이클을 관리하는 조직입니다.

•

광고 영상 : '뭔가' 다르다- 장애인 포용 경영 I 쿠팡로지스틱스서비스

•

인터뷰 영상: 장애인 사무직/ 스포츠직 직원들의 생생한 회사 이야기

업무 내용

① 장애인 채용 운영 및 관리

• 장애인 채용 공고 작성 및 관리
• 지원자 검토 및 인터뷰 프로세스 운영
• 채용 일정 관리 및 현업 커뮤니케이션
• 채용 결과 정리 및 리포트 작성
• 직무 요구사항 분석 및 JD(Job Description) 작성 지원

② 채용 데이터 분석 및 성과 관리

• 채용 관련 주요 지표 관리 (지원율, 합격률, 충원율 등)
• 채용 결과 데이터 정리 및 인사이트 도출
• 채용 성과에 대한 논리적 설명 및 보고
• 채용 효율 개선을 위한 데이터 기반 제안

③ 채용 관련 제반 운영 지원

• 채용 프로세스 운영 기준 관리
• 채용 관련 문서 및 운영 프로세스 정비
• 채용 채널 관리 및 운영 지원
• 유관부서와의 협업 및 커뮤니케이션

④ 장애인 직원 인사 운영 및 제도 관리 지원

• 장애인 직원 관련 HRM,인사 운영 지원
• 근무 및 고용 안정성 확보를 위한 제도 운영 지원
• 인사 기준 및 운영 프로세스 정비
• 제도 개선 관련 데이터 정리 및 검토 지원

자격 요건

• 채용 또는 HR 관련 경험 3~7년
• 숫자에 대한 이해도가 높고 데이터 해석이 가능한 분
• Excel 활용 능력 (데이터 정리, 함수 활용 가능 수준)
• 채용 결과 및 데이터를 논리적으로 설명할 수 있는 역량
• 문서 작성 능력 및 커뮤니케이션 역량
• 업무를 구조화하여 정리하는 능력

우대 사항

• 장애인 채용 또는 다양성 채용 관련 경험
• HR 운영 또는 인사기획 경험
• 인사 데이터 추출, 분석, 전략보고서 작성 가능자

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

전형 절차

• 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
• 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
• 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

참고 사항

• 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
• 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
• 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
• 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
• 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
• 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

• 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy

서류 반환 정책

• 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
• 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
• 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupangls.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
• 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
• 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

Job Description:

Pacific Life is investing in bright, agile, and diverse new talent to contribute to our mission of innovating our business and creating a superior customer experience. We're actively seeking a talented Institutional Marketing Strategy Director

to join our Institutional Retirement Solutions Group (IRSG).

This role can be based in Newport Beach, CA, Omaha, NE, or another approved Pacific Life office location.

As Institutional Marketing Strategy Director, you will serve as a strategic marketing partner to IRSG leadership, helping translate business strategy, market dynamics, customer needs, and competitive intelligence into clear marketing priorities and differentiated market strategies.

The role spans Pacific Life's institutional retirement businesses, including Pension Risk Transfer (PRT), Defined Contribution Lifetime Income (DCLI), Stable Value, and emerging retirement solutions. You will help leadership determine where Pacific Life should focus, how the organization should position itself, which audiences and opportunities matter most, and how marketing can influence growth.

You will bring together market intelligence, customer and audience insights, competitive understanding, positioning, messaging, thought leadership, and go-to-market strategy to help IRSG build preference and strengthen its position in the marketplace.

This is a highly visible leadership role at the intersection of business strategy, market intelligence, marketing strategy, and growth. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable analyzing a market, challenging a business assumption, shaping a narrative, and translating strategy into action.

How You'll Help Move Us Forward:

Lead and Evolve Institutional Marketing Strategy

• Own, activate and evolve the established IRSG marketing strategy, ensuring it remains aligned with business priorities, market opportunities, customer needs, and the maturity of each business.
• Partner with senior business and functional leaders to identify the markets, audiences, opportunities, and priorities where marketing can have the greatest impact.
• Translate business strategies and established marketing priorities into actionable audience strategies, positioning, messaging, content, and go-to-market recommendations.
• Evolve strategic direction along with business goals and strategies for the Institutional content roadmap, ensuring priority themes, audiences, and timing are informed by business objectives, market and customer insights, and go-to-market needs, while partnering with the broader marketing team on development and execution.
• Develop business-specific marketing approaches that recognize the distinct needs and market positions of Pension Risk Transfer (PRT), Defined Contribution Lifetime Income (DCLI), Stable Value, and emerging institutional businesses while maintaining alignment with the established IRSG narrative and strategy.
• Monitor market, business, and competitive developments and recommend strategic adjustments as priorities and opportunities evolve.
• Lead ongoing marketing planning and prioritization, establishing clear trade-offs and aligning marketing resources, investments, and activity to the highest-value business priorities and measurable growth objectives.

Drive Market Intelligence and Competitive Insights

• Serve as a strategic consumer of market, customer, and competitive intelligence, bringing relevant insights into IRSG marketing and business discussions.
• Partner with internal strategy, analytics, research, product, distribution, and other teams to identify and leverage available market and customer insights.
• Monitor key industry, competitor, regulatory, and market developments and assess their implications for IRSG marketing priorities and business objectives.
• Identify gaps in market or customer understanding and help define the research or analysis needed to inform strategic decisions.
• Translate complex market and competitive information into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for business and marketing leaders.
• Bring an external perspective to marketing strategy, helping identify emerging opportunities, shifts in audience needs, and potential areas of differentiation.

Steward Positioning, Messaging, and Market Narrative

• Serve as a steward of IRSG's established positioning, value proposition, and overarching narrative, ensuring they are consistently and effectively applied across marketing initiatives.
• Translate established positioning and value propositions into audience-specific messaging and marketing strategies for PRT, DCLI, Stable Value, and emerging institutional businesses.
• Partner with business and product leaders to apply the established positioning to priority initiatives, launches, campaigns, and market opportunities.
• Identify opportunities where changing market dynamics, customer needs, or competitive activity may warrant refinement or evolution of existing positioning and messaging.
• Ensure consistency and differentiation across institutional marketing efforts while allowing messaging to reflect the distinct needs and maturity of each business.
• Partner with other marketing teams to bring the established positioning and narrative to life across channels and experiences.

Guide Institutional Thought Leadership

• Provide strategic direction for institutional thought leadership priorities, ensuring they align with the established IRSG marketing strategy, narrative, positioning, and business objectives.
• Partner with business leaders and subject matter experts to identify priority topics and opportunities where thought leadership can support market engagement and business goals.
• Translate business priorities and market developments into recommendations for thought leadership themes, audiences, channels, and timing.
• Partner with operations, digital and other marketing resources to ensure thought leadership initiatives are strategically focused and effectively executed.
• Advise on executive visibility, industry engagement, conferences, speaking opportunities, and other external opportunities based on business and marketing priorities.
• Evaluate the effectiveness and relevance of thought leadership efforts and recommend adjustments as business priorities and market dynamics evolve.

Inform Go-to-Market and Growth Initiatives

• Provide strategic marketing leadership for new products, market expansion efforts, strategic initiatives, and emerging growth opportunities.
• Assess market readiness, audience needs, competitive dynamics, and differentiation opportunities to inform go-to-market strategies.
• Partner with product, distribution, communications, analytics, digital, and other marketing teams to translate strategy into execution.
• Help define target audiences, market priorities, value propositions, and channel strategies for priority initiatives.
• Provide strategic marketing counsel on business cases, executive presentations, strategic communications, and other high-priority business materials.
• Identify opportunities to strengthen the connection between marketing activity and the customer and distribution journeys that influence growth.

Measure Impact and Evolve the Strategy

• Establish frameworks for evaluating marketing effectiveness, market impact, and progress against strategic priorities.
• Define meaningful KPIs for marketing strategies, thought leadership initiatives, market engagement, and priority growth programs.
• Use data, analytics, research, and business results to evaluate what is working and where strategy should evolve.
• Regularly assess the effectiveness of marketing investments and recommend changes in priorities, resources, or approach.
• Champion a culture of accountability, learning, and continuous improvement across institutional marketing.

The Experience You Bring

• 10+ years of experience in strategic marketing, financial services marketing, institutional marketing, business strategy, consulting, product marketing, market intelligence, or a related discipline.
• Demonstrated experience developing marketing strategies that are directly connected to business growth and strategic priorities.
• Strong understanding of institutional financial services, retirement markets, insurance, investments, asset management, or related B2B financial markets.
• Experience translating market, customer, competitive, and business intelligence into strategic recommendations.
• Proven ability to influence senior leaders and build alignment across complex, matrixed organizations.
• Experience developing positioning, segmentation, value propositions, messaging, go-to-market strategies, or related strategic marketing frameworks.
• Exceptional communication, presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to make complex subjects clear and compelling.
• Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to move from insight to recommendation to action.
• Demonstrated ability to operate strategically while working effectively with teams responsible for execution.

The experience you bring:

• Experience in Pension Risk Transfer, Defined Contribution, retirement income, Stable Value, asset management, insurance, or adjacent institutional markets.
• Experience working with institutional buyers and influencers, including consultants, intermediaries, advisors, plan sponsors, institutional investors, recordkeepers, or retirement-focused organizations.
• Experience building or leading market intelligence, competitive intelligence, customer insight, or strategic planning capabilities.
• Experience developing thought leadership strategies and executive positioning programs.
• Experience supporting large-scale growth, transformation, innovation, or new-market initiatives.
• MBA or advanced degree preferred.

What Makes You Stand Out

• You think beyond the marketing function. You understand how markets, customers, competitors, products, distribution, and business strategy come together to create growth.
• You are naturally curious. You want to understand what is changing in the market, why it matters, and what Pacific Life should do about it.
• You turn complexity into clarity. You can take a complicated business issue or market dynamic and turn it into a clear point of view, strategic recommendation, or compelling story.
• You connect strategy to action. You know when to stay at the strategic level and when to translate strategy into specific priorities for the teams responsible for execution.
• You can influence without owning everything. You build trust with senior leaders and cross-functional partners and can move work forward in a highly matrixed environment.
• You understand that differentiation is earned. You look beyond claims and messaging to identify the capabilities, perspectives, and market opportunities that can create meaningful competitive advantage.
• You bring executive presence. You are comfortable challenging assumptions, presenting recommendations, and engaging with senior leaders on complex business and market issues.

Why This Role Matters

This role serves as the strategic marketing connector across IRSG—bringing together business priorities, market intelligence, customer insight, competitive understanding, and marketing execution to ensure the organization's marketing strategy remains aligned to business needs and responsive to the marketplace.

With the IRSG marketing strategy and overarching narrative established, the Director will help activate and evolve that strategy across Pension Risk Transfer, Defined Contribution Lifetime Income, Stable Value, and emerging retirement solutions. The role will translate strategic priorities into focused marketing initiatives, inform future planning through ongoing market and competitive intelligence, and ensure that marketing efforts are differentiated, audience-relevant, and connected to measurable business outcomes.

The position will also look beyond the current roadmap, identifying emerging market opportunities, shifts in customer and competitive dynamics, and future strategic needs that should inform the next evolution of IRSG's marketing strategy.

Ultimately, this role ensures that marketing operates as a strategic business partner—not simply an execution function—helping IRSG strengthen market position, build preference, and support sustainable growth.

Scopely is looking for a Lead Systems Designer to join our Star Trek Fleet Command team in the UK on a remote basis.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day – whether in our work environments alongside talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating in the mobile games industry, connecting millions of players around the world daily.

Star Trek Fleet Command is a standout success in the gaming industry. Launched in 2018, our in-house developed 4X MMO has continually evolved, earning its place as one of the top-grossing games on the market. Our next chapter is bold: we’re evolving the traditional 4X experience in STFC — and we need a bold design leader to shape the content and loops our players engage with on a daily basis.

What You Will Do

As a Lead Designer on STFC, you’ll own the standards, direction, and experiences that define how millions of players experience growth and mastery across our monthly content releases and beyond.

• Become the design owner and leader behind the feature pipeline, directing designers and UX specialists in crafting compelling experiences for our players
• Guide teams through the creative process, ensuring they can hit the vision of the game and deliver upon player and product needs with accuracy
• Get hands on through direct involvement in building and refining novel gameplay experiences focused on resource generation, spending, time gating, and power growth
• Create systems that foster meaningful player agency and long-term investment
• Manage and mentor designers in systems and economy design to elevate our standards and craft incredible experiences
• Shape the design process to ensure the standards of players are met and exceeded
• Use tools (Excel, Google Sheets) to model economies and progression pacing
• Collaborate with experienced, driven and passionate Designers, Product Managers, Analysts, and Engineers to implement features which aim to advance the genre
• Evaluate performance using data, player feedback, and your own playtest experience
• Design for scale: plan for long-term content extensibility and system health

What We're Looking For

• 2+ years of game design leadership experience
• Proven experience in F2P systems design and progression modelling
• 8+ years of experience designing systems or economies for live, F2P games (preferably MMO, 4X, or strategy genres)
• Confident people manager and mentor, who is able to grow & nurture talent
• Experience with all aspects of game design discipline: concept, game progression, interface, monetisation, and retention
• A proven track record of delivering features that balance player fun, engagement, and monetisation
• Ability to translate KPI targets and data into design direction for teams
• Mastery of spreadsheets and confidence in balancing power curves, pacing, and resource flow
• Experience working cross-functionally and navigating live production environments
• A positive, thoughtful, and collaborative approach to game development

Bonus Points

• Deep understanding of the 4X genre with specific experience in F2P 4X
• Familiarity with SQL, scripting, or simulation tools
• Love for Star Trek, sci-fi, or highly strategic social games
• Previous work on alliance or co-op systems in large-scale games

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role:

Multi-Agent systems are becoming an increasingly important part of how AI is deployed, whether via fast small-model subagents inside a product, or large groups of agents solving very large problems. Training Claude to be maximally effective and safe within large groups is a challenging new area of reinforcement learning, and represents a new axis for scaling test time compute.

We are looking for researchers who have experience training multi-agent systems at the largest scale and an appreciation for the incentives and mechanism design that come into play.

Responsibilities:

• Help create and optimize environments and data for model training that maximize Claude’s performance or ease of use on agentic tasks
• Ideate, develop, and compare the performance of different agent harness configurations (eg memory, context management, communication architectures for agents)
• Design and implement rigorous quantitative benchmarks for large scale agentic tasks
• Work with our product org to find solutions to our most vexing challenges in applying agents to our products

You may be a good fit if you:

• Have experience with large-scale RL on language models
• Have experience training multi-agent systems
• Enjoy going deeply into the roots of a problem and understanding its foundations, rather than its surface.
• Have good communication skills and an interest in working with other researchers on difficult tasks
• Have a passion for making powerful technology safe and societally beneficial
• Are excited for a mission-driven org with fast-paced, impactful work

Representative projects:

• Design and build reinforcement learning environments to train groups of Claudes how to solve problems together efficiently
• Design and build agent affordances that unlock new capabilities and scales of agents, while keeping the Bitter Lesson in mind
• Design and build a novel eval that measures how large teams of agents interact in groups to solve problems

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$500,000—$850,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
